    We design and build websites for businesses in Nairobi and across Kenya. Our team plans the structure, designs the pages and builds the site so it is easy to use and easy to manage. This service is for business owners who need a clear, reliable web presence that supports their work.

    Request a free consultation today

    What makes a website work for your business?

    Your website is often the first place people look when they want to learn about your business. It needs to say what you do, show what makes you different and make it easy for someone to get in touch. We build sites with those basics covered from the start.

    • Site architecture
    • Optimised for search
    • Distinctive web design
    • Multi-channel ready
    • Scalable sites
    • Conversion-focused layouts

    We handle the design and build in one place. We start by agreeing on the pages and structure, then design each page and build it so you can edit it later. Throughout the work we keep you involved and explain our choices in plain language.

    Contact

    • What goes into a website plan?

      Before we design anything, we map out how the site will be built. That means agreeing on the pages you need, how they connect, and how people will move between them. A clear plan keeps the build focused and makes the site easier to manage later.

    • How will people find my site?

      A site only works if people can find it. We set up the basics of search optimisation during the build, from clear page titles to sensible links between pages. That gives you a starting point. If you want more visibility, we also offer SEO as a separate service.

    • Why does design matter?

      Your site should look like your business and be easy to use. We design pages that reflect your brand and make it clear what you offer. The aim is a site you are happy to share and that visitors can understand quickly.

    • How does my site fit with other marketing?

      A website sits at the centre of your other marketing. We build pages that work with search, paid ads and social activity, so visitors arrive on a page that matches what they clicked on. We plan for this during the build rather than after.

    • Can my site grow with my business?

      Businesses change, and your site should be able to change with them. We build on content management systems that let you add pages, posts or products yourself. That means you can keep the site up to date without coming back to us for every edit.

    • How much does a website cost?

      Pricing depends on the scope of the project, including the number of pages, the design work needed and any extra features. We look at what you need and give you a clear quote before work starts. Get in touch to talk through your project.

    Contact Chuech Studio

    Why does a good website matter for your business?

    A website can look good and still fail if people cannot find it or use it. We design for both. Pages are structured so search engines can read them, and layouts are checked on phones and laptops. The result is a site that is straightforward to run and supports the rest of your marketing.
